About Embassy

Our Story

Embassy Tabernacle Church was founded as a spiritual home for families seeking a deeper walk with Christ, practical teaching and a community committed to service. From weekly worship to local outreach, our mission is to raise ambassadors who represent the love, wisdom, and hope of Jesus wherever they go.

"Raising Ambassadors rooted in Christ"

Shepherding with purpose
